visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman wearing a white and blue snowboarding jacket, black helmet, and goggles performs a small jump and spin on a snowy slope. The background features a bright blue sky, a ski lift, and other skiers. (2) The same woman attempts a 180-degree spin but loses her balance and falls onto the snow, smiling and laughing toward the camera as others sit nearby on the slope. (3) A person in a bright red jacket and brown pants performs a high jump with arms outstretched, lands successfully, and moves toward the camera for a fist bump. (4) The woman in the white jacket performs a quick hopping spin and points her finger toward the camera while sliding. (5) A man wearing a colorful tie-dye jacket and orange pants jumps and spins 180 degrees, then faces the camera to give a fist bump. (6) The woman performs a controlled tail-press spin, lands smoothly, and fist bumps the camera lens. (7) She attempts another trick but falls backward onto the snow, maintaining a cheerful expression and extending her hand for a fist bump. (8) A person in a dark green hoodie and green goggles performs a series of rapid hops and spins while sliding down the slope. (9) A person in a black hoodie and beige pants performs technical 'buttering' tricks, spinning multiple times on the snow before fist bumping the camera. (10) The woman is sitting on the snow, uses her legs to flip the snowboard up vertically, then looks at the camera and fist bumps. (11) She performs one final 180-degree spin trick on the moving board and approaches the camera for a final fist bump.
